thread:
amanda: Heads up — planning a staggered wave for runtime + router + console tomorrow 22:00 UTC. Need pinlist, eviction check, and a short rollback runbook. @deploy-bot can you reserve the window?

deploy-bot: Scheduled wave for 2024-06-06 22:00 UTC (window 90m). Will create canaries and provide wave id. wave_id=wave-20240606-01

luqman: Which exact service versions are we pinning? runtime has the new batching kernel; want to be explicit about fallback targets.

amanda: Proposed pins: runtime=2.3.1, router=1.8.0, console=0.9.4. Fallback: runtime=2.3.0, router=1.7.9, console=0.9.3.

nora: Adding console eviction note: console push may trigger prefix eviction on small pools. Need to confirm KV cache headroom in dedicated pools. @sre-oncall can you check pool cushions?

sre-oncall: Quick check: dedicated-runtime-pool avg free mem 18%, kv-cache headroom ~12% in eu-west. Risk window if 2x traffic during canary. Recommend prewarm and set eviction grace to 60s.

ryan: Rollback criteria suggestion: any 5xx spike >1.5x baseline sustained for 3 minutes OR p99 latency >2s on API route /v1/generate for canary traffic. If triggered, auto rollback to pinned fallback and notify #incidents.

amanda: Plan outline: 1) canary 5% for 10m, 2) canary 25% for 10m, 3) ramp to 60% for 15m, 4) full. Manual hold between steps. If any metric trips, roll back to pinned fallbacks.

luqman: For API compatibility: runtime 2.3.1 requires router header `x-kv-prefetch: true` for optimal batching. Will the router variant be compatible? router 1.8.0 has opt-in. We should add test header on canary route.

nora: I'll add a console flag to opt-out of aggressive garbage collection during the window: `GC_MODE=conservative`. Patch ready here: https://git.redwood/console/changes/345

deploy-bot: Wave wave-20240606-01 created. Canary route: `route=/canary/wave-20240606-01/*`. To schedule pins run: `deploy-bot pin --wave wave-20240606-01 --pins runtime=2.3.1,router=1.8.0,console=0.9.4`

amanda: Please attach release notes snippet to the wave. Minimal items: batching kernel toggle, router header opt-in, console GC mode flag, rollback criteria.

ryan: I'll draft the release note and the quick rollback playbook. Quick rollback CLI: `deploy-bot rollback --wave wave-20240606-01 --to runtime=2.3.0,router=1.7.9,console=0.9.3 --reason=\"metric_trip\"`

luqman: Can we confirm canary telemetry will surface model quality regressions? Add the evals proxy to the canary route for 100 sampled requests.

nora: Added: `EVAL_SAMPLE=100` env on console canary. Also toggled `GC_MODE=conservative` for console pods in the canary pool.

sre-oncall: Prewarm plan: create 3 extra runtime pods with kv-cache preload -> command: ```
kubectl -n runtime scale deployment/runtime-canary --replicas=6
kubectl -n runtime exec -it runtime-canary-0 -- /usr/local/bin/preload_kv.sh --prefixes \".config,.user\"
```

amanda: Thanks. Canaries will run in eu-west only for first two steps. After green we open to us-east.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic steering rules prepared. Step triggers: manual confirm or metrics pass. Alerts wired to #eng-sre and #eng-releases.

ryan: Quick check: retention of traces for this wave should be 7d. Set trace TTL to 7d to aid investigations.

luqman: One more: router sticky session TTL must be >= 1h for consistent KV cache hits during rollouts. Set `sticky_ttl=3600` on canary route.

nora: Done. Console config updated and pushed to canary pool.

amanda: Final ask — everyone please ack if you can be on-call/monitoring during 22:00-23:30. If no ack we'll assign SRE rotation.

ryan: ack, I'll monitor API and traces.

luqman: ack, I'll watch router and batching metrics.

nora: ack, console will standby for rollback patch.

sre-oncall: ack, I'll own eviction and infra signals.

amanda: Great. Deploy notes: `wave-20240606-01`, pins documented, canary route `route=/canary/wave-20240606-01/*`, rollback CLI example in the wave ticket. See you at 21:45 UTC for a final quick sync. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Wave wave-20240606-01 status=ready. Reminder: run `deploy-bot preflight --wave wave-20240606-01` 30m before window starts.

amanda: will do. Closing thread for now, will reopen with preflight output.
